title: Genie Hacker Ritual
description: A young woman in a pink genie outfit and blue headscarf kneels on a messy bedroom floor, taking a selfie with a smartphone while reaching toward a large ornate mirror. Inside the glowing pink and blue mirror, a muscular blue demon with horns stands behind a smaller version of the woman who is holding a laptop.
prompt: A cluttered teenage girl's bedroom with clothes, energy drink cans, and pizza boxes scattered everywhere. A woman dressed as a pink genie with a blue veil and face mask kneels on the floor taking a selfie with her phone while reaching toward a large ornate black mirror. Inside the mirror a glowing pink and blue portal reveals a muscular blue horned demon standing behind a miniature version of the genie who is using a laptop, string lights hang above, computer monitor showing green code on the desk, highly detailed digital painting
